agent: foreign minister wave, collecting session: the AI's decisions and prepared wars (OpenHOI3 stage 5, 2026-10-16)
question: What the foreign minister's day does after its Lua: the prepared wars a decision can be tied to, their pruning, the walk that posts them and the readiness test it asks; and how the decision score is converted.

addresses.name: CAIStrategy_IsReadyForWar
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CAIStrategy_IsReadyForWar(CAIStrategy* strategy, CCountryTag target, CCountryWarTargetValue* entry)
addresses.comment: **Whether a prepared war is ready** - asked by CAIForeignMinister::DoWork's walk of WarTargets. Counts the fronts the theatre layer draws (COwnerArea +0x74): for each area of the strategy's country (CCountry +0xD30) with a neighbouring area whose first province the target controls, once per area, every front of it and every province on it that is in a real area. Each edge but kind 3 to a simulated province the target controls in a real area makes that province an enemy one, whose land units' strength (CUnitList_SumLandStrength) is added once to the enemy's strength; a province with any such edge is a front province, counted, and its own land units out of battle cool-down (+0xD4 <= 0) whose average strength and organisation shares (CUnit_GetStrengthAndOrganisationShares) are both >= 990 (static VA 0x1B15020, floor(990.5f)) add their strength to ours; a front province with none is empty. Then by the entry's date (+0x1C): three months or more since it was prepared, enemy x 660 / 1000 (floor(660.5f), VA 0x160A654), and **Japan** (country database +0x24, the fifth cached tag) **with fewer than four front provinces is ready**; under three months a x330 branch (VA 0x160A6E0) tests a date three months later still and so never runs. Not ready where empty x 1000 / fronts > 300 (static VA 0x1B1502C, floor(300.5f)); else ready where the enemy's strength <= ours. No front at all answers ready. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section E.
addresses.evidence: Listing VA 0x8ADEF0..0x8AE4F2: two `ret 0x10` (0x8AE495, 0x8AE4D5) and four pushes at both DoWork call sites (strategy, tag, id, entry). The thresholds' initialisers at VA 0xD10780 and 0xD10480 are `floorf(dword [0x160A754] = 990.5f)` and `floorf([0x160AAB4] = 300.5f)` stored to 0x1B15020 and 0x1B1502C. JAP: the .rdata name array at 0x15C1DE4 reads GER, ENG, SOV, USA, JAP, so +0x20/+0x24 is the fifth. Would be wrong if COwnerArea +0x74 were not the fronts - FINDINGS-supplynetwork.md records it so.

addresses.name: CAIStrategy_PruneWarTargets
addresses.comment: **Drops old small war targets while a great one is prepared** - DoWork calls it after the cached proposal, only where the country is a major (+0x15C) or its max_ic (+0x60C) > 100. A target's month is years x 12 + month from its date (+0x1C), worked as DoWork's day is. First walk: the last target in WarTargets (+0x148) that is a major or > 100 IC, and its month; none, return. Second walk: every other target neither major nor > 100 IC with (thatMonth - itsMonth > 1) or (nowMonth - itsMonth > 3) is taken off - flagged where the list's deferred-delete byte (+0x154) is set, else unlinked, freed and the count (+0x150) lowered - and deleted (slot 0 with 1), +0xF4 set where it is a neighbour (CCountry +0xF58); the walk goes on. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section C.3.
addresses.evidence: Listing VA 0x8AD9B0..0x8ADD3F `ret 4`, int3 to 0x8ADD4F before CAIStrategy::IsPreparingWar. `cmp byte [ecx+0x15c],0` / `cmp dword [ecx+0x60c],0x64` at 0x8ADA23/0x8ADA2C and again at 0x8ADBE7/0x8ADBF8; `cmp ecx,1; jg` and `cmp eax,3; jle` at 0x8ADC77/0x8ADC80; `dec dword [edi+0x150]` at 0x8ADCEF then the walk resumes at 0x8ADD26 - the decompiler's `return` after the free is not in the listing. Caller: DoWork at VA 0x89D73D.

addresses.name: CUnitList_SumLandStrength
addresses.comment: The strength of the land units of a list (the list's head in EAX): *out = 0, then for each unit whose slot 15 (IsLand) holds, its brigades' +0x5C summed (regiments at +0x38) and added; answers out. Unlike CUnit_TotalLandStrength it does not go down into a unit's children. CAIStrategy_IsReadyForWar sums an enemy province's units with it. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section E.
addresses.evidence: Listing VA 0x5D64F0..0x5D6538 `ret 4`: `mov edi,[eax]` (the head), `mov dword [ebx],0`, `call [edx+0x3c]`, `add edx,[ecx+0x5c]` over `[esi+0x38]`. Caller VA 0x8AE17D after `lea eax,[esi+0x2b8]` (CMapProvince units).

addresses.name: CUnit_GetStrengthAndOrganisationShares
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CUnit_GetStrengthAndOrganisationShares(CUnit* unit, int* strength, int* organisation)
addresses.comment: A unit's average strength and organisation as shares of their most, in thousandths: for each brigade (+0x38) strength x 1000 / GetMaxStrength (slot, -1 where the most is 0) added to *strength and organisation x 1000 / CSubUnit::GetMaxOrganisation to *organisation; then, where it has brigades (+0x40), each sum x 1000 / (count x 1000). The callers zero both first. CAIStrategy_IsReadyForWar counts a unit at both >= 990. The thousandths sibling of the recorded GetUnitAverageStrengthAndOrganisation (0x1C7250, floats). The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section E.
addresses.evidence: Listing VA 0x5C70E0..0x5C723F `ret 0xc`; the 0x189373/0x39580E overflow test of the thousandths division twice, then __allmul/__alldiv by count x 1000. Caller VA 0x8AE212 with both outs zeroed at 0x8AE20A/0x8AE20E.

addresses.name: LuaForeignMinisterTick_Call
addresses.comment: Makes the call Lua_ForeignMinister_Tick prepared, where the proxy's called flag (+0x10) is clear: sets it, pushes the minister (0x49E8D0) and calls through proxy +8 with 1 argument and no result; a Lua error throws luabind::error, which DoWork catches and reports (ReportLuaError). Then the stack is restored. The shape of LuaEvaluateDecision_Release. Bare `ret`. One caller, CAIForeignMinister::DoWork. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Likely: decompiled whole - `if (!*(char*)(proxy+0x10)) { flag; FUN_0089e8d0(); call proxy[2](L,1,0); nonzero -> throw luabind::error; lua_settop }`, bare `ret` at VA 0x89E5A9; called from DoWork at VA 0x89D6A7 right after Lua_ForeignMinister_Tick with ESI the proxy. Inferred only in that 0x49E8D0 (the argument push) was not opened.

addresses.name: CAIForeignMinister::DoWork
addresses.comment: **Virtual slot 10 - the foreign minister's day.** Sets countdown `+0x30 = 1`, so it is entered every AI pass; a skip-once byte `+0x70` is cleared and ends the pass; then it acts only in the hour `(country id (+0x38) + 13) % 24 == (tick - 0x29C55C0) % 24`. In order: (1) CAIForeignMinister::AnswerPendingOffers; (2) the Lua `ForeignMinister_Tick(minister)` (Lua_ForeignMinister_Tick, LuaForeignMinisterTick_Call; a luabind::error is reported and the day goes on) - every shipped script calls ExecuteDiploDecisions first; (3) the cached proposal at `+0x58`, posted with CEU3AI::PostAction when its score `+0x5C` > 50.0 (0x160A4C8), then released, +0x58 = 0, +0x5C = -1.0f; (4) CAIStrategy_PruneWarTargets, only for a major (+0x15C) or max_ic (+0x60C) > 100; (5) **the walk of WarTargets** (CCountry +0x5D4 = strategy +0x148). First walk, in order: a target this country holds military access into (status +0x4C) gets a CMilitaryAccessAction with value 0 posted (CMilitaryAccessAction_Construct, value cleared at VA 0x89D7E7) and **the day ends**; a neighbour (CCountry +0xF58) is put to CAIStrategy_IsReadyForWar - ready goes straight to the second walk, unready sets a flag and goes on; the flag set at the end ends the day. Second walk, every target from the start: one that is ready and **has a decision (+0x18)** is asked `potential` then `allow` in a fresh CEventScope seeded by one MT19937Next draw on gamestate +0x124, the country the minister's, and posted with PostExecuteDecisionCommand - no Lua score; one **without** a decision gets a CDeclareWarAction (VA 0xA11DF0) - limited where the entry is (+0x14) or the faction rule limited_war (+0xDDC) holds - with the war goal `conquer`, or first `vichy_war_goal` (GER on FRA), `barbarossa_war_goal` (GER on SOV) or `japan_USA_goal` (JAP on USA) where IsSelectable and that goal's IsValidWithTrigger hold, falling back to `conquer` and posted where IsSelectable holds. Nothing takes a target off. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, sections A and D; FINDINGS-ai.md.

addresses.name: LuaEvaluateDecision_CallInt
addresses.comment: Runs the call Lua_ForeignMinister_EvaluateDecision prepared: marks the proxy called (+0x18), pushes its three arguments (rva 0x49E920) and calls through proxy +8 with **3 arguments and 1 result**; a Lua error throws luabind::error. **The result must be a number** (lua_type 3) or luabind::cast_failed is thrown; it answers the Lua DLL's lua_tointeger of it - `fld; fistp`, **rounded to the nearest, ties to even** (FINDINGS-luahost.md) - and pops. `ret 4` at rva 0x49E720. One caller, ExecuteDiploDecisions. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-foreignminister.md, section B.
